about: Extraction and membrane separation: pressurized solvent extraction, solid-phase extraction, supercritical fluid extraction, flow liquid-liquid extraction, tangential-flow ultrafiltration, electrodialysis.

excluded.biotage_selekt: a flash chromatography system: its run (gradient, fractions, detector) is the chromatography class; an extraction view would duplicate it
excluded.gilson_cpc250: centrifugal partition chromatography: a chromatography run (mobile phase, rotor, fractions), primary in chromatography

method.configure:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: the method of {inst} cannot change now (cells loaded, a process ran, or a flush / test is active).

method.configure:LIQUID_PHASE_GUARD.message: at that temperature the solvent would boil at this pressure in {inst}.

flush.start:NO_POSITION_SELECTED.message: no cell position of {inst} is selected for the flush.

acquisition.stop:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: nothing to do; see `chemlab run {inst} status`.

unsupported.flow: the extraction flow is a method setting (method flow=...); the free-running service pump needs a manual valve path

method: a setting left out is kept from the current method (the per-cycle step list is rebuilt from cycles / hold / discharge); the method can change only before the lab loads the cells.
manual: operating manual pp. 50-60 (creating methods, parameters)
set-temp: preheats the heating block (before loading the cells); the run needs the block at the method temperature.
pressure: the pressure is a method setting: this sets the method pressure and keeps the rest of the method.
prime: flushes the solvent lines of the selected cell positions (flush settings: --time = solvent flush time).
manual: operating manual pp. 36-45 (activating positions, flushing)
start: manual: operating manual pp. 50-60 (extraction cycle stages)

method.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} refused the start although deck, method, utilities, manifold and pressure are ready: the solvent reservoirs do not hold enough for every stroke, or liquid is left in the pipette / extraction position.
method.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: ask the lab to refill the reservoirs (or use smaller volumes / fewer repetitions in the method).

run.prime:NOT_ENOUGH_SOLVENT.message: the reservoir of that inlet on {inst} does not hold the prime volume.
run.prime:NOT_ENOUGH_SOLVENT.fix: prime a smaller volume, or ask the lab to refill it.

run.prime:INVALID_ARGUMENT.message: that inlet of {inst} has no solvent assigned.
run.prime:INVALID_ARGUMENT.fix: add --solvent ID to assign one (see `chemlab help {inst} prime`).

pressure.set:INVALID_ARGUMENT.message: {inst} takes pressure set points in 0.1 bar steps only.

unsupported.flow: flows belong to each SPE step (method flow=... drain=...)
unsupported.vent: nothing to vent: the positive-pressure manifold releases itself (`pressure off` sets it to 0)

alternatives.flow: `chemlab run INST method load=1mL wash=1mL elute=1mL flow=6mL/min drain=6mL/min`.

method: an SPE method is three steps: load, wash, elute (volume per stroke, at most 1 mL); flow / drain / reps apply to all steps, PHASE.flow etc. to one; each step draws from the deck solvent position of its name unless PHASE.solvent= says otherwise.
manual: user manual pp. 28-34 (method operations and parameters)
prime: primes one solvent inlet (S1-S5) with --volume (default 15 mL; about 2 x 15 mL replace a line); --solvent assigns a library solvent first (an inlet without one cannot be primed).
manual: user manual pp. 35-42 (assign solvents and prime)
start: the method run path (method.start); the touch-screen Prepare Run dialog (run.prepare / run.setup / run.start) stays available with `chemlab call`.
manual: user manual pp. 35-48 (start, monitor and control a run)
pressure: manual: user manual pp. 35-42 (adjust air pressure)
